body: Engineering check, 14 Nov 2026: verified on an emulator (build 151) against VM 108 (sha-35a086e); not the release-candidate pair. '00s Hip Hop > a song by two artists (Hate It Or Love It): the long-press menu offers "Go to The Game" and "Go to 50 Cent" and "Go to album"; tapping "Go to 50 Cent" closes the sheet and opens 50 Cent's page (no false "Could not find"). A song with one artist (In Da Club) keeps the single "Go to artist" line.
